summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on November 2, 2026 its board determined CEO Yehiel Tal would cease serving effective immediately, tied to a broader cost-reduction plan, and appointed Deputy CEO/CFO Eran Rotem as CEO while he retains the CFO role at unchanged compensation. Tal resigned as Interim Chairman but remains a director; separation terms follow his employment agreement and compensation policy. The plan also discontinues regenerative medicine R&D, while rhCollagen production continues. Watch execution risk, cash runway, and any further board or cost actions.
